# How much Statutory Maternity Pay does your employee get?

> Free UK SMP calculator for 2026/27: enter the due date, average weekly earnings and employment start to check eligibility, the qualifying week, the 39-week pay schedule and Statutory Paternity Pay. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
